mapper.select: SELECT T.Totle_Trade_Id tradeId,T.TRADE_DATE coveringDate FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T WHERE T.Totle_Trade_Id = #{tradeId}

SELECT null as tradeId, bcid.BOOKSET_ID prodId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR prodAbbr, bcid.BOOK_DATE coveringDate, facr.CAWLBACK_RULE coveringWay, bcid.CLAWBACK_AMT actualAmount, '02' AS coveringForm,
ffas.accr_end_date covCycleEndDate, ffas.accr_str_date covCycleStartDate,
bcid.BOOK_DATE covCycleStartDate, bcid.BOOK_DATE covCycleEndDate,
'01' tradeStatus, bci.CLAWBACK_AMT theoryAmount, fci.ccy ccy FROM BOK_CLAWBACK_INFO_DETAIL bcid INNER JOIN BOK_CLAWBACK_INFO bci ON bci.BOOKSET_ID = bcid.BOOKSET_ID AND bci.LAYERING_ID = bcid.LAYERING_ID AND bci.HAPPEN_DATE = bcid.HAPPEN_DATE AND bci.BOOK_DATE = bcid.BOOK_DATE INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = bci.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO fci ON fci.FINPROD_ID = bci.FINPROD_ID AND fci.FINPROD_TYPE = #{COMMON_BUSINESS_TYPE_01} and fci.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_06} AND fci.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C11} INNER JOIN FIN_CLAWBACK_CALC_RULE facr ON facr.CASH_ID = fci.CASH_ID AND facr.EFF_DATE = (SELECT MAX(f1.EFF_DATE) FROM FIN_CLAWBACK_CALC_RULE f1 WHERE f1.CASH_ID = fci.CASH_ID AND f1.EFF_DATE <= bci.HAPPEN_DATE)
inner join fin_float_accrual_sche ffas on facr.cash_id = ffas.CASH_ID and ffas.val_date = bcid.happen_date
where 1=1
and fp.finprod_id = #{prodId}
and bcid.HAPPEN_DATE = to_date(#{bookDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')

SELECT distinct A.FINPROD_ID id, A.FINPROD_ABBR text, D.IS_LAY ||',' || D.PORTFOLIO_ID object FROM FIN_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT A1 ON A.FINPROD_ID = A1.p_Finprod_Id INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ ON PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = A.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO C ON (A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID OR A.P_FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID) INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD D ON A.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID and D.issue_status = #{ISSUE_STATUS_01} WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID
AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE} AND A.PROFIT_TYPE != #{PROFIT_TYPE_02,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EXISTS( SELECT * FROM FIN_CASH_INFO C WHERE C.CASH_TYPE_1=#{CASH_TYPE_1_06,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND (A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID OR A1.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID) )
and ( A.FINPROD_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR A.FINPROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
and A.FINPROD_ID = #{initValue}
